_comment: Expected `next build` render mode for every route, asserted by scripts/assert-route-classification.mjs after a build. Guards the conversion-track payoff (3.0.4.8+3.0.4.9): a route must not silently regress to a more dynamic mode. Modes: 'static' = ○ (fully prerendered), 'partial' = ◐ (partial prerender — static shell + request-time <Suspense> holes), 'dynamic' = ƒ (server-rendered per request). New routes must be added here or the check fails. If a change is intentional, update this file in the same commit. Choosing a mode (priority, weighed against the page's purpose): prefer 'static' first; if the page needs request-time data, isolate it in a <Suspense> hole so the shell still prerenders ('partial'); use 'dynamic' only when the whole screen is genuinely per-request (/api/* handlers, mutations, per-request auth/DB). Counterweight — never force a more-static mode than the page honestly supports; a truly full-screen dynamic surface should be dynamic, not contorted into a fake shell.

_reasons./: Static hero shell; the signed-in board is a client slot reading /api/account/board; ?demo and auth_error are Suspense dynamic holes.
_reasons./atlas: Site-framed landing: PageHead is the static shell while the session check streams the guest sign-in landing or the signed-in listing and catalogue from a request-time hole; a selected map covers that chrome with the full-viewport canvas.
_reasons./opengraph-image: Deploy-static: the social-card fonts are read once at module scope with top-level await (the documented Cache Components pattern for bundled request-independent assets), so the handler's render path performs no IO and the build prerenders the PNG deterministically. Awaiting the file reads inside the handler made this route's mode flap between static and dynamic across identical builds.
_reasons./icon.svg: The tab icon is a literal src/app/icon.svg file, not a generated handler, so the metadata route prerenders to a static asset with no request-time input. The sibling src/app/favicon.ico is the legacy fallback and is filtered out of this check by assert-route-classification.mjs.
_reasons./sites: The hourly cached priced catalogue prerenders whole: filter chrome and every site card. Cards or table is an account preference read in the browser, and the table's searchParams-driven sort streams over the same table unsorted; client in-view refresh keeps price figures current.
_reasons./sites/[id]: Per-site detail (params + DB + live prices) streams from a dynamic hole.
_reasons./sites/[id]/opengraph-image-38dcjp: Parameterized metadata-image handler; Next 16 classifies it as dynamic while its only data dependency remains the hourly cached, price-tagged site detail and the file convention caches the response by default. The -38dcjp suffix is Next's metadata-route disambiguator, added once this handler moved under the (site) route group: getMetadataRouteSuffix appends djb2Hash(parentPathname) base36 whenever a parent segment is a group or parallel segment, so it is derived from the path alone and changes only if the handler moves again.
_reasons./admin: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the rail's badges, the range selector, and the overview (needs-attention list, actions, status cards, audience) then stream from request-time Suspense holes; visx charts are client-only islands inside them.
_reasons./admin/health: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the service levels, scheduled tasks, and event log then stream from request-time Suspense holes.
_reasons./admin/esi: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the live error budget, rate-limit pressure, price-source health, and ESI cost then stream from request-time Suspense holes.
_reasons./admin/traffic: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the activity chart, traffic lists, and pilot sign-in breakdown then stream from request-time Suspense holes.
_reasons./admin/search: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the Search Console performance, queries, index coverage, and sitemaps then stream from request-time Suspense holes.
_reasons./admin/queue: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the refresh-queue summary and dead-letter retry list then stream from request-time Suspense holes.
_reasons./admin/statics: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the section head with its feed-check form and the pending statics snapshot then stream from a request-time Suspense hole.
_reasons./settings/characters: Per-user: the settings hub layout keeps the page head, section rail, and section head in the static shell (the rail's admin group appears once the client session resolves); the session-gated character-management list (link / switch active / unlink) is a request-time dynamic hole with a content-shaped skeleton.
_reasons./settings/corporations: Per-user: section head in the static shell; the session-gated Station_Manager corp-sharing controls and membership list are a request-time dynamic hole with a content-shaped skeleton.
_reasons./settings/preferences: Per-user: the section head and the registry-resolved preference groups prerender (values hydrate client-side from the preferences store); only the session check that sends signed-out visitors home is a request-time hole, rendering nothing.
_reasons./settings/account: Per-user: section head in the static shell; the session-gated overview (active character, linked count, session count, created date) plus the purge / log-out-everywhere / delete controls are a request-time dynamic hole.
_reasons./admin/users: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the admin search, role grants, and role-change audit then stream from a request-time Suspense hole (moved from /settings/access).
_reasons./admin/users/[userId]: Per-user, admin only: the whole console renders after the admin check, so its static shell is the site frame and a loading line; the user detail (a user's linked characters + sessions; force-unlink / reassign / force-logout) then streams from a request-time Suspense hole (moved from /settings/access/[userId]).
_reasons./api/admin/wh-statics: Dynamic admin form mutation: same-origin refresh, promote, or reject action followed by a 303 redirect.
_reasons./api/cron/refresh-wh-statics: Dynamic weekly cron: conditional community-feed probe and lock-guarded pending snapshot write.
_reasons./api/dev/synthetic-pilot: Development localhost POST: resets the reserved test pilot and its access, then issues a session cookie and redirects home. Requires matching Host and Origin. GET is inert.
_reasons./preview/primitives: Admin-gated primitive reference: the page chrome prerenders and the session check plus rendered interactive sheet stream from a request-time Suspense hole.
_reasons./preview/widgets: Widget isolation page: SDE-backed site identifier is cached into the prerender and widgets load their public detail endpoint after mount; partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./industry: Industry workspace, Profiles section — the shared industry layout (section tabs + structures drawer) is the static shell; the job-feed character ids come from a 'use cache: private' read of the session's linked characters, so the per-session App Shell carries them on navigation, and profiles, structures, skills and job slots load client-side into remembered stores (/api/account/industry-profiles, /api/account/structures, /api/account/industry-slots, the personal + corp job feeds).
_reasons./industry/[id]: Per-blueprint planner — the [id] param and the cached structure, pricing and history stream from a hole that per-link prefetches resolve ahead of the click; open-timing metrics are a request-time sibling hole; page chrome is the static shell.
_reasons./industry/jobs: Industry workspace, Active jobs section — the shared industry layout and page container are the static shell; the linked characters (names, portraits, scope health) come from a 'use cache: private' read, so the per-session App Shell carries them on navigation, and the personal and corporation job boards are fetched client-side into remembered stores (/api/account/industry-jobs, /api/account/corp-industry-jobs).
_reasons./industry/planner: Industry workspace, empty Planner section — the shared industry layout and the centred blueprint search are the static shell; results come client-side from the static blueprint index (/api/industry/blueprints). Partial because the layout's structures drawer is a request-time session hole.
_reasons./changelog: The newest changelog master is a cached file read + parse, and the shared rail's active-version highlight is isolated in Suspense around usePathname. Partial because the shared header's Tranquility chip is a request-time io() hole.
_reasons./changelog/[slug]: Older changelog masters are prerendered from generateStaticParams and the same cached parse, but partial: the shared rail's active-version highlight reads usePathname in Suspense, and the master body awaits params inside its own Suspense hole so soft navigations between masters stay instant. Unknown and newest-master aliases render the not-found boundary as a streamed 200 with injected noindex (the documented Cache Components soft-404 contract).
_reasons./api/industry/blueprints: Blueprint search index is deploy-static SDE data (cached 'max', SDE-tag revalidated), so the handler prerenders to a static JSON asset — no per-request input.
_reasons./api/industry/stations: Manufacturing NPC station index (name, system, security) is deploy-static SDE data with ESI-resolved names (cached 'max', SDE-tag revalidated), so the handler prerenders to a static JSON asset — no per-request input. Matched client-side by the profile facility picker.
_reasons./api/industry/systems: Universe system search index (every persistent solar system — K-space, Pochven, J-space) is deploy-static SDE data (cached 'max', SDE-tag revalidated), so the handler prerenders to a static JSON asset — no per-request input. Matched client-side by the systems search source (the build-location pickers + the structure-pin control).
_reasons./api/universe/assets: Dynamic no-store manifest: connection() defers the SDE-version read to request time so each map session discovers the current immutable asset version.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/systems: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/adjacency: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/assets/[version]/wormholes: Dynamic version-addressed JSON handler: the SDE-tag-cached payload gates its own version and successful responses are immutable.
_reasons./api/universe/statics/[systemId]: Dynamic path-addressed JSON handler over the shared tag-cached promoted wormhole statics dataset; valid unknown systems return an empty picker list.
_reasons.dynamic /api/*: Route handlers — per-request by nature (auth, mutations, DB queries, crons, external calls). Justified dynamic.
_reasons./api/maps/jump: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: doorbell/confirm/typed-hole jump-resolver entries verify the session user per request, read Convex evidence + Neon geography, and dispatch the transactional authoring door — genuinely per-request.
_reasons./api/maps/access: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request requires map-admin authority, commits one Neon grant upsert or revoke, and reconverges the complete one-way Convex access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/delete: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request atomically requires active-map admin authority, starts the durable undo window, and tears down the live access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/restore: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request atomically requires archived-map admin authority inside grace and rebuilds the one-way access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/purge-now: Dynamic authenticated creator-only mutation route: marks an archived map for the next scheduled purge without deleting chain data directly.
_reasons./api/cron/purge-maps: Dynamic daily cron: lock-guarded bounded Neon eligibility scan, resumable Convex map-chain purge, then durable tombstone.
_reasons./api/cron/daily-batch: Dynamic daily cron: runs the map purge, price, industry-index, and Monday wormhole-statics steps in order within one invocation.
_reasons./api/maps/create: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each request rate-limits one user, commits one Neon map-plus-grants transaction, and drives the one-way Convex access projection.
_reasons./api/maps/search-characters: Dynamic authenticated read route: each request selects an owned linked token for scoped ESI typeahead or uses the public exact-name fallback when no scoped token exists.
_reasons./api/maps/signature-elimination: Dynamic authenticated mutation route: each acting-user trigger reads current Convex map evidence and promoted Neon statics, runs the pure eliminator, and dispatches one transactional assumed-tier write batch.
_reasons./api/sync-leave: Dynamic authenticated mutation: the Atlas pagehide beacon retires one tab's location sync subject per request.
_reasons./contact: Static contact page; partial only because of the header's TQ status hole.
_reasons./legal: Static legal page; partial only because of the header's TQ status hole.
_reasons./preview/cards: Static card preview over mock sites; partial only because of the header's TQ status hole.
_reasons./codex: The guide listing is a 'max'-cached read tagged codex:index, so the index prerenders; the admin's New guide control streams from a small session hole beside the list.
_reasons./codex/[kind]/[key]: Codex reader for signed-out viewers: the kind and key params and the tag-cached current revision stream from one hole behind a page-shaped skeleton, and the route imports no admin code.
_reasons./codex/[kind]/[key]/admin: Codex page for signed-in viewers, reached through the proxy rewrite: the params, the tag-cached revision, the viewer's admin check, and the edit query stream from one hole behind a page-shaped skeleton; the admin's editor loads only after a pencil press.
_reasons./codex/[kind]/[key]/history: Per-page revision history, admin only: the admin check, params, and the uncached revision list stream from one hole behind a skeleton.
_reasons./api/admin/codex/revisions: Dynamic admin form mutation: same-origin publish or restore with a compare-and-set on the page head, followed by a 303 redirect.
